plain_statement: The 14 listed numbers are the 14 inputs of the Heawood graph written as bit columns over 58 test inputs: its 21 edges, then its 37 maximal independent sets; the target column 2^21 - 1 is true exactly at the edges. Some list of at most 26 different numbers, none of them an input column, each the bitwise AND or OR of two earlier columns (inputs included), contains the target column.
title: A step toward: Search: a circuit of AND and OR gates with at most 26 gates for the edge function of the Heawood graph
